title: LaszloApartman | Apartments, bookings and guests for Windows
heroTitle: Your apartments organised. Your daily tasks in one place.
heroText: Manage apartments, bookings, guests, arrivals and departures in one clear Windows application. Three languages, with data stored locally.
platform: Windows · HU / EN / ES · one computer
featuresTitle: Less repeated entry. A clearer view.
featuresIntro: You do not need to type every event again. One booking form connects the guest, apartment, booking, arrival and departure.
f1Text: Check availability and capacity for your dates and party size. The apartment booking table helps you choose; overlapping bookings are checked when saving.
f2Text: Select an existing guest or add a new one on the same form. Booked nights are calculated automatically and bookings are listed by date.
f3Text: Separate arrival and departure lists with their own times. Saving the combined booking creates linked events; key handovers and returns can be imported from bookings.
f4Text: Arrivals, departures, cleaning and maintenance appear in a shared overview. Click an event to open its original record; add other tasks separately.
f5Text: Income totals count only received payments. Apartment monthly income is calculated automatically and cards open detailed lists. Pending entries remain visible in the list.
f6Text: Local attachments, document records, expiry dates and useful contacts. Documents expiring within 30 days are flagged automatically.
s1Text: Enter arrival, departure and the number of guests.
s2Text: Check availability, capacity and existing bookings.
s3Text: Choose a guest or add a new one; a single save creates the booking and both events.
workflowNote: Separate menus remain available for reviewing and editing. Changing a booking updates its linked arrival and departure.
galleryText: Application screenshots in Hungarian, English and Spanish. Screenshots change with the selected language. Click an image to enlarge it.
pricingTitle: Start with three apartments. Expand when you need to.
pricingIntro: A 30-day free trial without a license code. Then a 2-year license for one computer. Prices exclude VAT.
customText: 10 or more apartments, according to your needs.
upgrade: Upgrade the 3/6/9 apartment plans by paying the price difference, until the original license expiry. For example, 3 → 6 apartments: €8 + VAT.
changes: Custom modifications from €10 + VAT per request, depending on the task and subject to a prior quote.
ownText: Set your display name and initials in the Manager profile. The default initials are LA; you can personalise the application.
localText: Your records are stored on your computer. Make regular backups with the built-in backup feature. This is not a multi-user cloud service.
q1: What do I need to get started?
a1: A Windows computer and the installer. Customers do not need to install Node.js to use the installed application.
q2: How do I get a license?
a2: Send your selected plan and the computer ID shown in the application. After agreement and payment, you receive a license file to activate with the Load license file button.
q3: Can I use it on another computer?
a3: A license is tied to one computer. Another computer needs a separate license; contact the seller when replacing your computer.
q4: What happens when the trial or license expires?
a4: The application switches to read-only mode: viewing data, opening documents and backup/export remain available. Adding or editing data requires a valid license.
q5: Does it connect to online booking platforms?
a5: The current version is a local registry. It does not include automatic Booking.com or Airbnb synchronisation.
contactTitle: Would you like to try it?
contactText: Tried the application? Contact us for a license, plan upgrade or custom change. Payment instructions and your license file are arranged by email.
subject: LaszloApartman enquiry
testNote: Real application screenshots with test data.
homeTitle: A calmer day managing your rental apartments.
homeText: Bookings, guests and daily tasks for Windows — from one shared form, in three languages.
downloadIntro: Windows 10 / 11 · 64-bit · Hungarian, English and Spanish interface. The installed application does not require Excel, Python or Node.js.
installerText: Download and run the installer, then launch the application from the desktop shortcut. The free trial supports up to 3 apartments.
manualText: An 18-page illustrated guide to everyday use, booking entry, backups and license activation.
paymentText: A 30-day free trial without a license code. Afterwards, your selected plan needs a 2-year license for one computer. Base plan: 3 apartments, €17 + VAT / 2 years. See above for 6 and 9 apartment plans and custom upgrades.
paymentSteps: Email your selected plan and computer ID from License and plans in the application. After agreement, we send bank transfer instructions. Once payment is received, the license file is sent by email; activate it using Load license file.
securityText: The installer is currently not digitally signed, so Windows or your browser may warn about an uncommon download or unknown publisher. This alone is not a malware detection. Check the download source and checksum; keep Windows protection enabled.
vtNote: In the attached scan report, none of the 68 scanning engines detected malware. The result applies to the version 2.1.11 installer at the time of analysis. View the current report through the VirusTotal link.
avgNote: According to the attached screenshots, AVG found no threats at the end of its scan of the LaszloApartman 2.1.11 installer and the application EXE file. The images show the scan results for those files at the time of analysis. The original AVG messages are in English.
